mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_device_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.* FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_device_session s JOIN tianquan_oauth.oauth_authentication a ON a.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND a.jti_digest = s.authentication_jti_digest JOIN tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state u ON u.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u.target_type = 'SUBJECT' AND u.target_key = s.subject JOIN tianquan_oauth.oauth_security_state r ON r.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND r.target_type = 'REALM' AND r.target_key = 'self' WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.subject = #{subject} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.expires_at > #{now} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status <> 'REVOKED' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.enabled AND r.enabled AND a.subject_generation = u.generation AND a.realm_generation = r.generation AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_authorization g WHERE g.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND g.device_session_id = s.id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.absolute_expires_at > #{now} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY s.authenticated_at, s.id
mapper.update: UPDATE tianquan_oauth.oauth_device_session SET status = #{po.status}, expires_at = #{po.expiresAt}, revoked_at = #{po.revokedAt}, reason_code = #{po.reasonCode}, version = #{po.version}, update_user_id = #{po.updateUserId}, update_time = #{po.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{po.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE tianquan_oauth.oauth_device_session SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', version = version + 1, update_time = #{now}, update_user_id = #{actor} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id IN ( SELECT s.id FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_device_session s JOIN tianquan_oauth.oauth_authentication a ON a.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND a.jti_digest = s.authentication_jti_digest WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at <= #{now} - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND a.expires_at <= #{now} - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_authorization g WHERE g.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND g.device_session_id = s.id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED )
